# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest released version of `veriphy`.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's
[security advisories](https://github.com/georgedouzas/veriphy/security/advisories/new)
rather than opening a public issue. You can expect an acknowledgement of your report and, once the
issue is confirmed, coordination on a fix and disclosure timeline.
